title: Vendor / tool selection — Core architecture & frameworks
transcript:
Principal Engineer: Alright, let's dive into the serverless deployment options. I've gathered some thoughts from the team.

Backend Lead: I've been looking at Google Cloud Run, seems promising but...

Mobile Lead: Hang on, what about Azure Functions? I've heard good things.

Staff Engineer: I've also been considering AWS Lambda, but we've had issues with AWS in the past.

Principal Engineer: All valid points. Let's discuss the pros and cons of each.

Backend Lead: Google Cloud Run has a favorable pricing structure, but it's a new platform for us, and we're not sure about the migration process.

Mobile Lead: That's true. Azure Functions would be a good fit, but we're worried about the learning curve and support.

Staff Engineer: AWS Lambda has decent pricing and support, but we've found AWS services to be cumbersome in the past.

Principal Engineer: Given our current team situation, we need to consider the risks and disruptions of adopting a new platform.

Mobile Lead: I agree. The current tools are outdated and hindering mobile development.

Backend Lead: I understand your concern, but we need to consider innovation as well. Sticking with the status quo might stifle it.

Principal Engineer: A valid point, but we need to prioritize stability given the team attrition we're experiencing.

Staff Engineer: I suggest we make minor enhancements to our existing tools instead. We're already proficient in them, and it would minimize risk.

Mobile Lead: Alright, but we need to re-evaluate this decision in three months if the situation doesn't improve.

Principal Engineer: Agreed. I'll also investigate potential cost savings with these enhancements.

Backend Lead: Sounds like a plan. I'll own the implementation.

Staff Engineer: CIO has signed off on this decision.

Principal Engineer: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda. John, can you update us on the mobile app redesign?

John: Sure, I'll be wrapping up the design this week and then we can start the handoff to the development team.

Principal Engineer: Excellent. Let's continue the discussion on that next week.

[2-3 turns off-topic exchange]

Assistant: Alex, have you seen the new coffee machine in the break room?

Alex: Oh, really? I haven't had a chance to check it out yet. Let's take a quick break and go check it out.

[Returning to the meeting]

Assistant: Alright, back from the coffee break. Let's continue with the agenda.

Title: Decision on Platform Migration and Team Strategy

In the recent meeting, it was decided to maintain the existing architecture with minor enhancements to minimize risk and disruption during the current team attrition. Team attrition will be monitored, and the decision to reconsider new platforms will be re-evaluated in three months. The CIO presided over the discussion.
